description.value: Walmart Supercentre at Burnaby Metrotown is a large-format big-box store carrying groceries alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and baby goods. The location includes an in-store pharmacy and garden centre, making it one of the most comprehensive one-stop supply stops in the Burnaby area. Touring cyclists passing through the Metrotown corridor can stock up on a wide range of food and household staples.
